pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

gate_frame.desc: the gate's stone arch, an opening 10.8 wide and 16 tall at the crown; in front of the teeth; pivot on the ground at its middle

gate_teeth.desc: the gate of stone teeth, behind the arch: down (shut) at rest; it rises a notch (about 3 units) per push of the gear and falls back if the pushing stops; pivot at its bottom middle

gear.desc: the wall gear, clean: turn it about its hub; pivot at the hub

gear_jammed.desc: the wall gear jammed with grit, before the Tune-up; pivot at the hub

signpost.desc: the Luff signpost's stone post; the pointer turns on its axle at (0, 10.4); pivot on the ground

signpost_pointer.desc: the pointer, a stone arrow with Luff glyphs: hang it drooping (rotate -100°) while broken; once fixed it swings round to point at the stump; pivot at its axle

signpost_crank.desc: the crank, a wooden handle on the post's side (in front of it at the axle); turn it about its hub as Torque fixes the post; pivot at the hub

draw_order_gate: gear / gear_jammed (on the wall beside it)
